text:
alex: Quick status — we want a staggered optkit rollout this week. Canary to eu-west first, then us-west, then us-east. Need clear owners for: canary metrics, runtime kernel bump, quant profile validation, and CRs for rollback logic. Anyone take canary ownership?

mira: I can own canary metrics + dashboards. What metric list do you want me to surface?

alex: Thanks @mira! Add p50/p90 latency, tokens/sec, OOM count, model-serving-errors, and a quant-regression-rate on our eval set. If you want a template I can drop one in the dashboards channel.

sam: I can do quant profile validation. Which model variants are in scope for the canary?

alex: Start with m1-base-8bit and m2-chat-quant (the ones in the optkitprofile/2026-03 branch). If those look good we expand.

lia: Runtime note — we need a kernel bump (fused-gemm patch) in us-west for stable 8-bit perf. @jon, can infra schedule that?

jon: Yes — we have a maintenance window Wed 02:00 UTC. I can coordinate the kernel bump and smoke tests.

sam: For quant validation I've got a quick eval harness. Run locally or in CI:
```
./scripts/eval_quant.sh --models m1-base-8bit,m2-chat-quant --dataset small-regressions --save-logs=/tmp/quant-check
```
Threshold: fail if quant-regression-rate > 1.5% or PPL increases > 2%. I'll open a PR with CI outputs.

alex: CR ping @sam @mira — please add at least 10 representative prompt vectors to the canary bundle and include those in the CI eval. Also add an automatic fallback policy: if quant-regression-rate > 1.5% for 30m -> rollback to fp16 variant.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance for node pool patch on Wed 02:00 UTC (us-west).

mira: Got it — adding panels + alert rule: quant-regression-rate > 1% for 30m -> pager. I'll also add the rollback runbook steps (how to switch the routing policy and pin model-version).

lia: One more dependency: eng-runtime needs model-io change (#457) landed before we push quant profiles. Timeline?

jon: We can land #457 by Tue EOD if no blockers. I'll flag any issues in the PR.

alex: Action recap: 1) @mira dashboards + alerts + runbook, 2) @sam quant validation + PR + CR, 3) @jon schedule & land #457 + smoke tests Wed 02:00 UTC, 4) @lia confirm no infra surprises post-kernel bump. I'll post final rollout checklist tomorrow AM. Ping me in-thread if blockers show up. :thumbsup:

mira: Ack — will have dashboards + alerts up before the window.

sam: Ack — will open PR by EOD Mon and request reviews.

jon: Ack on schedule and smoke test plan.

alex: Thanks all — keeping this as the single source for rollout questions.
